mission: Ben shifts from reactive to proactive. The breach was a field test; Veraine is heading for Veranthos. The group names what she has been doing — engineering, not studying — and Ben stops deferring and sets the new agenda.
why_now: Midpoint turn. The story cannot pursue Veraine one more node at her pace; the group has to get ahead of her, and Ben has to be the one who speaks it first.
conflict: Ben's instinct is still solo-control. The breach has made solo impossible and he has not yet made the full shift to 'we need a plan.' The scene's quiet argument is between the single-pronoun and plural-pronoun versions of the sentence he is forming.
turning_point: Ben pulls up the Corridor map and traces a route that does not follow Veraine but cuts ahead of her. He turns to the five people in the cockpit. The order he gives is the first proactive order of the mission.
opening_hook: Back aboard the Steady Returns, the breach zone shrinking behind them, Ben's hands are shaking. Not from the de-structuring. From the decision forming in his mind.
closing_hook: Veraine is heading for Veranthos. She's days ahead. Ben looks at his crew — battered, frightened, argumentative. 'We need a plan.'
emotional_trajectory: Shaken aftermath -> crystallizing resolve -> first proactive leadership

stakes.personal: Ben's identity moving from the son carrying his father's legacy into the commander the room has needed
stakes.interpersonal: The group needs Ben to lead, not just facilitate
stakes.external: Veraine heading for Veranthos with a tested methodology

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — cockpit, departure from the breach zone
sensory_details: Ben's hands shaking on the copilot's controls; the lattice restored but feeling fragile after Kolven — he knows now what its absence weighs; Desh's steady hands beside his; five faces packed into the small cockpit
action_beats: Ben grips the copilot's controls with shaking hands as the breach zone shrinks in the viewport behind them
Ben pulls up the Corridor map and traces a new route — not following Veraine's trail but cutting ahead to intercept
Ben turns to face the five people crammed into the cockpit and speaks the first proactive order of the mission
notes: H13 planted — Veraine heading for Veranthos. Midpoint turn lands: Ben is no longer asking what happened but deciding what to do. He is still thinking partly in 'I' rather than 'we' — the final crossing is Ch21. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, narrate his own leadership transformation. The scene records his shaking hands and the order he speaks, not an interior paragraph about the shift. The 'we need a plan' line is the exit; the chapter does not continue past it. Voice: Zahn-procedural, clipped, the kind of scene where the dialogue is shorter than the breath between lines.
